from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyShareInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures the outstanding share or unit count and name from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or trust in the document")
    instrument_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of security reported (e.g., 'shares', 'units')")
    outstanding_count: float | None = Field(description="The numeric count of outstanding securities")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which the count is valid")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the count information")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyShareInfo]
